LanguageData.LP_AC_SteelCut.label: iron-cleaving form
LanguageData.LP_AC_SteelCut.description: Arcanum (fighter, circle 6): for 30 seconds all attacks ignore armor. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_Immovable.label: immovable as a mountain
LanguageData.LP_AC_Immovable.description: Arcanum (fighter, circle 7): for 30 seconds, immune to stuns, can't be downed, damage taken ×0.5. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_SwordDomain.label: sword saint's domain
LanguageData.LP_AC_SwordDomain.description: Arcanum (fighter, circle 8): for 20 seconds a sword aura covers 3 cells around you, resolving a melee attack on one enemy in range every 0.5 seconds (using your current melee weapon, damage × martial power). Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_Warlord.label: lord of armies
LanguageData.LP_AC_Warlord.description: Arcanum (fighter, circle 9): all friendly humanlikes on this map get melee hit +15%, better shooting accuracy, damage dealt ×1.15 and no mental breaks for 1 day. Cooldown 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_CloudStep.label: cloud step
LanguageData.LP_AC_CloudStep.description: Arcanum (monk, Cloud Ascendant, circle 6): leap to any open spot within 25 cells, ignoring walls and terrain; on landing, enemies within radius 2 take 15 × martial power blunt damage and are stunned for 1 second. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_CloudHand.label: cloud hand
LanguageData.LP_AC_CloudHand.description: Arcanum (monk, Cloud Ascendant, circle 7): strike a 15-cell palm force from afar, 40 × martial power blunt damage, ignoring half the armor and knocking the target back 3 cells. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_CloudBody.label: cloud body
LanguageData.LP_AC_CloudBody.description: Arcanum passive (monk, Cloud Ascendant, circle 8): movement ×1.3, immune to stuns.
LanguageData.LP_AC_SkyFall.label: ninefold heaven strike
LanguageData.LP_AC_SkyFall.description: Arcanum (monk, Cloud Ascendant, circle 9): soar into the clouds for 3 seconds (untargetable meanwhile), then plunge to a point within 30 cells: enemies within radius 4 take 60 × martial power blunt damage and are stunned for 5 seconds. Cooldown 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_JudgmentChain.label: chains of heaven's punishment
LanguageData.LP_AC_JudgmentChain.description: Arcanum (paladin, circle 6): bind one enemy within 20 cells with holy chains for 10 seconds, leaving it barely able to move; meanwhile each time it attacks it takes 20 × divine power (× psychic sensitivity) holy damage itself. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_RadiantShield.label: radiant shield
LanguageData.LP_AC_RadiantShield.description: Arcanum passive (paladin, circle 7): after each Divine Smite (or other holy smite-type ability), gain a shield absorbing 30 × divine power damage for 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_AC_Sanctuary.label: sanctuary
LanguageData.LP_AC_Sanctuary.description: Arcanum (paladin, circle 8): mark a sanctuary of radius 5 at a point within 20 cells for 1 hour: allies recover 2 × divine power injury per second, fiends and undead take 5 × divine power holy damage per second. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_AngelDescent.label: angelic descent
LanguageData.LP_AC_AngelDescent.description: Arcanum (paladin, circle 9): summon a celestial angelic attendant (an aasimar, a fine fighter, damage taken ×0.5, melee damage ×1.5) to fight alongside you for 1 day, departing as motes of light when time is up. Cooldown 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_CantripMastery.label: conjuration mastery
LanguageData.LP_AC_CantripMastery.description: Arcanum passive (wizard, circle 6): wizard level 1 abilities cost 0 mana.
LanguageData.LP_AC_PrismWall.label: prismatic wall
LanguageData.LP_AC_PrismWall.description: Arcanum (wizard, circle 7): raise a 10-cell-long prismatic wall (perpendicular to the cast direction) at a point within 25 cells for 1 hour: enemies on the wall take fire, frost, lightning and acid damage of 8 × arcane power (× psychic sensitivity) each per second. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_Simulacrum.label: simulacrum
LanguageData.LP_AC_Simulacrum.description: Arcanum (wizard, circle 8): copy one friendly humanlike within 20 cells out of ice and snow: the simulacrum has the same race, gender and skill levels but only half the toughness (damage taken ×2), and melts after 3 days. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_TruePolymorph.label: true polymorph
LanguageData.LP_AC_TruePolymorph.description: Arcanum (wizard, circle 9): permanently turn one enemy within 20 cells into an animal that belongs to you (big targets become grizzly bears, others timber wolves). No effect on legendary creatures, story bosses and targets of body size 3+. Cooldown 10 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_HolyWordHeal.label: holy word healing
LanguageData.LP_AC_HolyWordHeal.description: Arcanum passive (cleric, circle 6): Cure Wounds and Mass Cure Wounds also clear one disease or addiction from each person healed.
LanguageData.LP_AC_DivineWord.label: holy word
LanguageData.LP_AC_DivineWord.description: Arcanum (cleric, circle 7): speak the holy word of the god; enemies within radius 6: those with under 20% health left die on the spot, under 50% are stunned for 10 seconds, the rest are blinded for 1 minute. Legendary creatures and story bosses are only blinded. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_HolyAura.label: holy aura
LanguageData.LP_AC_HolyAura.description: Arcanum (cleric, circle 8): for 1 minute, you and allies within radius 6 take ×0.7 damage, and fiends and undead that attack them in melee are blinded for 10 seconds. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_TrueResurrection.label: true resurrection
LanguageData.LP_AC_TrueResurrection.description: Arcanum (cleric, circle 9): revive a humanlike corpse within 12 cells dead no more than 1 year, regrowing lost limbs and organs too; works even if the corpse has rotted to bones. No effect on liches and necromantic constructs. Cooldown 30 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_TreeStride.label: transport via plants
LanguageData.LP_AC_TreeStride.description: Arcanum (druid, circle 6): while standing by a tree (within 2 cells), step into it and come out by another tree on this map; up to 3 allies within 2 cells come along. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_RegenCircle.label: circle of regeneration
LanguageData.LP_AC_RegenCircle.description: Arcanum passive (druid, circle 7): during wild shape, recover 2 × primal power injury every 250 ticks; when returning to human form, heal another 20% of current injuries.
LanguageData.LP_AC_AnimalShapes.label: animal shapes
LanguageData.LP_AC_AnimalShapes.description: Arcanum (druid, circle 8): you and up to 4 friendly humanlikes within 5 cells wild shape together (bear form) for 1 hour, with strength based on your primal power. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_DragonForm.label: dragon form
LanguageData.LP_AC_DragonForm.description: Arcanum (druid, circle 9): become a true dragon for 1 hour: dragon claws 30, dragon bite 36 (armor penetration 40%), melee damage × primal power, damage taken ×0.5, movement ×1.3. Cooldown 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_SeekingSpell.label: metamagic: seeking
LanguageData.LP_AC_SeekingSpell.description: Arcanum passive (sorcerer, circle 6): sorcerer spells chase the target's vital spots; damage and healing ×1.25.
LanguageData.LP_AC_ExtendedSpell.label: metamagic: extended
LanguageData.LP_AC_ExtendedSpell.description: Arcanum passive (sorcerer, circle 7): sorcerer spell durations ×2.
LanguageData.LP_AC_ElementalForm.label: elemental avatar
LanguageData.LP_AC_ElementalForm.description: Arcanum (sorcerer, circle 8): become an elemental for 30 seconds: immune to fire, frost, lightning, electrical and acid damage, sorcerer spell damage ×1.3. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_SourceBurst.label: source burst
LanguageData.LP_AC_SourceBurst.description: Arcanum (sorcerer, circle 9): spend all your sorcerer mana (at least 1) and detonate it at a point within 25 cells: enemies within radius 5 take (15 per mana point) × innate power (× psychic sensitivity) arcane force damage. Cooldown 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_BloodFury.label: blood fury
LanguageData.LP_AC_BloodFury.description: Arcanum passive (barbarian, circle 6): while raging, damage dealt +5% for every 10% of health you've lost (up to +50%).
LanguageData.LP_AC_Unstoppable.label: unstoppable
LanguageData.LP_AC_Unstoppable.description: Arcanum passive (barbarian, circle 7): immune to stuns while raging.
LanguageData.LP_AC_Enlarge.label: giant form
LanguageData.LP_AC_Enlarge.description: Arcanum (barbarian, circle 8): your body swells for 30 seconds, melee damage ×1.5, damage taken ×0.8. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_EternalRage.label: eternal fury
LanguageData.LP_AC_EternalRage.description: Arcanum passive (barbarian, circle 9): rage no longer has a time limit and lasts as long as you're still fighting within 10 seconds; can't be downed while raging (you still die from excessive injuries).
LanguageData.LP_AC_Camouflage.label: natural camouflage
LanguageData.LP_AC_Camouflage.description: Arcanum passive (ranger, circle 6): after standing still for about 4 seconds while drafted you become camouflaged, and the next attack deals ×2 damage (removed after attacking or moving).
LanguageData.LP_AC_GaleArrow.label: gale arrow
LanguageData.LP_AC_GaleArrow.description: Arcanum (ranger, circle 7): fire a ricochet arrow with your current ranged weapon: after hitting the target it bounces to 2 other enemies within 8 cells of it, each a full shot. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_BeastEvolve.label: evolved beast companion
LanguageData.LP_AC_BeastEvolve.description: Arcanum passive (ranger, circle 8): your beast companion takes ×0.67 damage (equivalent to +50% health), melee damage ×1.3, movement ×1.1.
LanguageData.LP_AC_HuntGodEye.label: eye of the hunt god
LanguageData.LP_AC_HuntGodEye.description: Arcanum (ranger, circle 9): for 1 day, shooting accuracy greatly increased (almost always hits), ×1.5 damage against favored enemies. Cooldown 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_TrapMaster.label: trap master
LanguageData.LP_AC_TrapMaster.description: Arcanum passive (rogue, circle 6): never triggers any trap.
LanguageData.LP_AC_CripplingStab.label: crippling strike
LanguageData.LP_AC_CripplingStab.description: Arcanum passive (rogue, circle 7): after a sneak attack hits, the target's movement ×0.5 for 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_AC_PoisonKing.label: poison king
LanguageData.LP_AC_PoisonKing.description: Arcanum passive (rogue, circle 8): Poisoned Blade's poison amount ×2, also works on fleshy undead.
LanguageData.LP_AC_Shadowless.label: shadowless
LanguageData.LP_AC_Shadowless.description: Arcanum passive (rogue, circle 9): turn invisible for 3 seconds after each kill; can trigger repeatedly.
LanguageData.LP_AC_OtherGuardian.label: otherworldly guardian
LanguageData.LP_AC_OtherGuardian.description: Arcanum (warlock, circle 6): summon an otherworldly guardian based on your patron to fight alongside you for 3 days: an imp for the Fiend, a sprite for the Archfey, a quasit otherwise. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_SoulHarvest.label: soul harvest
LanguageData.LP_AC_SoulHarvest.description: Arcanum passive (warlock, circle 7): killing an enemy with eldritch damage (eldritch blast etc.) restores 1 pact mana.
LanguageData.LP_AC_MassFear.label: mass fear
LanguageData.LP_AC_MassFear.description: Arcanum (warlock, circle 8): enemies within radius 6 at a point within 20 cells are terrified and scatter for 15 seconds; legendary creatures and story bosses have a 50% chance to break free. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_SoulPact.label: soul pact
LanguageData.LP_AC_SoulPact.description: Arcanum passive (warlock, circle 9): hostile humanlikes you kill (except legendary creatures and story bosses) have a 50% chance to have their soul bound: they rise on the spot as your combat thrall, and after 3 days the soul disperses and they vanish as motes of light.
LanguageData.LP_AC_IrresistibleDance.label: irresistible dance
LanguageData.LP_AC_IrresistibleDance.description: Arcanum (bard, circle 6): one enemy within 15 cells is forced to dance for 20 seconds × inspiration power: can't attack or walk away, damage taken ×1.3. Success = 65% + (inspiration power - 1) × 40%, -5% per point of the target's Wisdom modifier, also offset by mind resistance; story bosses and legendary units dance 5 seconds at most. No effect on mechanoids. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_MassInvisibility.label: mass invisibility
LanguageData.LP_AC_MassInvisibility.description: Arcanum (bard, circle 7): all friendly humanlikes within 10 cells (including yourself) turn invisible for 30 seconds; attacking or casting reveals them. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_PowerWordStun.label: power word stun
LanguageData.LP_AC_PowerWordStun.description: Arcanum (bard, circle 8): all enemies within radius 5 at a point within 20 cells are stunned for 6 seconds × inspiration power; half the time for story bosses and legendary units. Works on mechanoids too. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_Foresight.label: foresight
LanguageData.LP_AC_Foresight.description: Arcanum (bard, circle 9): one ally (can be yourself) sees a moment into the future for 1 day: melee hit +25%, better shooting accuracy, melee dodge +25%, mind resistance +50%, can't be ambushed. Cooldown 7 days.
